predecessor.rule: No v1 live outcome is reused as a v2 prospective outcome.

purpose: Prospectively evaluate the Dream-Replay-selected ORP/Controller batching policy against the locked fixed_exploration_v0 baseline on eight newly generated held-out public-code discovery tasks.

policy_source.live_translation: Only batch_fraction controls live batch size. Both policies receive the same generated query and the same outcome-independent candidate order.

task_generation.evaluator_setup: Before either policy starts, the evaluator fetches all four pinned candidate files. This setup is not a policy observation and is excluded from policy probe cost.
target_line_candidates: UTF-8 line stripped of surrounding whitespace
occurs in exactly one of the four candidate files
task_generation.target_selection: Among all unique eligible lines, choose the line with the smallest SHA256(task_id + '|' + line).
task_generation.invalid_task: No unique eligible line or any setup fetch failure.
task_generation.policy_visibility: Policies receive task_id, query line, repo/ref and candidate paths, but not the target path or setup observations.

live_interface.action: HTTP GET one pinned raw GitHub file
live_interface.observation: exact generated query line occurs in fetched UTF-8 text
live_interface.stop: after the first completed batch containing >=1 match, or after all candidate files
live_interface.policy_cost: number of HTTP GET probes issued
live_interface.setup_overhead: recorded separately and excluded from policy cost/utility
live_interface.run_order: If SHA256(task_id)[0] is even, baseline runs first; if odd, dream runs first.

objective.information_gain: For a valid task with one unique target among four candidates, successful identification yields log2(4)=2 bits.
objective.primary: mean utility difference dream - baseline across all eight valid tasks
objective.noninferiority: dream resolution rate >= baseline resolution rate

decision_rule.evaluation_closure: All 8 preregistered templates generate valid unique queries; both policies execute from zero observations; evaluator and utility remain unchanged; predicted and actual IG/probes/rounds/latency/utility are logged.
decision_rule.controller_improved: evaluation_closure AND mean utility difference > 0 AND dream total probes <= baseline total probes AND dream resolution rate >= baseline
decision_rule.invalid_or_incomplete: fewer than 8 valid tasks or any required live rollout fails

claim_ceiling: Engineering evidence for this controller translation and benchmark family only. It does not establish general ORP superiority, VEA transfer, LoopCell capability accumulation, or C5 capability.
